data.narrative:
Dusty Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Tessa Lau and Philipp Herget that has raised $70M+. The valuation universe comprises 9 private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public comparable, though the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage transactions to support robust median-based triangulation.

Given data constraints, Stage-Progression represents the applicable valuation method. Using the $70M+ total raised as a proxy for an implied $4M base value at entry, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement yields $9M. This method reflects the company's progression through capital raises but lacks independent verification from a sufficiently narrow peer cohort in the robotics sector.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $7M (low) to $10M (high), with a median estimate of $9M. The range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage comparable transactions in robotics—only 1 peer met strict stage filters from a universe of 10 sector companies—and reliance on total capital raised rather than independent revenue or margin benchmarks. A narrower range would require additional Seed-stage robotics transactions or direct revenue/unit economics data from the target.
